observations: Torah LM2 #121 is a five-line oral teaching containing no explicit bechina equations. A new package requires at least 3 concepts connected by explicit bechina language ('X הוא בחינת Y') forming an independent thematic domain. This Torah has none. The teaching's conceptual vocabulary — תפלה (prayer), כוונה (concentration), גלגול (reincarnation), the division of the prayer service into sections — appears throughout other LM2 Torahs as part of well-established theme clusters. Nothing in this teaching is structurally novel enough to constitute an independent domain. The brief mention of 'מָארֵי דְּיָדַיִן וּמָארֵי דְּרַגְלִין' (masters of hands and masters of feet) — a kabbalistic division of soul-types into their corresponding limb-specialties — is explicitly deferred by the Rebbe to another location ('כַּמְבֹאָר בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר'), so it is not developed here into a bechina network that could seed a new package. No new packages are proposed.
